text: 金十数据7月11日讯，受强台风“巴威”影响，我国东部沿海部分地区发生强降雨天气，引发严重险情灾情。国家防汛抗旱总指挥部对福建、浙江启动国家防汛防台风二级应急响应。为深入贯彻落实习近平总书记关于防汛救灾工作的重要指示精神，近日，财政部、应急管理部紧急预拨4000万元中央自然灾害救灾资金，支持福建、浙江开展防汛防台应急抢险救灾工作，重点做好受灾人员紧急转移避险、排危除险等应急处置、开展次生灾害隐患排查和应急整治等，最大限度减少灾害损失和人员伤亡，切实保障人民群众生命财产安全。
text_en: July 11 (Jin10 Data) — Affected by strong Typhoon Bavi, some eastern coastal areas of China experienced heavy rainfall, triggering severe disasters and emergencies. The State Flood Control and Drought Relief Headquarters activated a Level II emergency response for flood and typhoon prevention in Fujian and Zhejiang provinces. To thoroughly implement General Secretary Xi Jinping's important instructions on flood prevention and disaster relief, the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Emergency Management recently pre-allocated 40 million yuan of central natural disaster relief funds to support Fujian and Zhejiang in flood and typhoon prevention emergency response and disaster relief operations, focusing on emergency evacuation and transfer of affected people, hazard removal and emergency treatment, conducting secondary disaster hazard inspections and emergency remediation, to minimize disaster losses and casualties, and ensure the safety of people's lives and property.
